mechanism: LLM scan of every file to select relevant codebase context once per issue, shared across sampled trajectories
evidence_scope: With parallel scaling, we can amortize up-front costs across multiple downstream samples, allowing us to identify relevant codebase context using the simple method of letting an LLM read every file.
evidence_role: Here, we explore this problem in the context of solving real-world GitHub issues from the SWE-bench dataset.
